preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 200.
Number of special nodes K and total nodes N satisfy 1 <= K <= N <= 200000.
Node a is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f_i <= N for f_i in f)
preconditions.description: Each special node f_i is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= N and 1 <= v_i <= N for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects nodes between 1 and N.
The number of edges is exactly N-1, forming a tree.

postconditions.description: The first line of output contains N integers representing the maximum values.
The second line of output contains N integers representing the special nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(max_values[i] == max(d(a, u) - d(i + 1, u) for u in f) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each max_values[i] is the maximum value of d(a, u) - d(i + 1, u) for any special node u.

postconditions.expression: all(special_nodes[i] in f and max_values[i] == d(a, special_nodes[i]) - d(i + 1, special_nodes[i]) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: Each special_nodes[i] is a special node that attains the maximum value max_values[i].
